race.comment: LILLIAN (11) was very impressive from the back last week at this track, rounding up her rivals with ease and clocking good splits late in the process. She's gone to another level this time in work and now drops a stack of weight as she rises in grade. May end up back in the run, but if she can improve again third-up it's danger signs for her rivals. SENSESSIONAL (2) was solid fresh over 1400m but this looks a recipe for success. He's known to fly second-up, as well as at this track and trip and everything looks to work out perfectly for him. He makes plenty of appeal. SILVER EYE (4) was just fair first-up but should be better as he gets out over further. The booking of Fiore is a good push for his chances and he boasts a good second-up record. Sharp improvement is expected. TOO DARDY (5) won last start and now rises to this trip for the first time. He creates plenty of interest. SNIPPY WHICH (6) is racing well and should give himself every chance up front.
